textos.Lançado em 2025 e dirigido por Ryan Coog: Released in 2025 and directed by Ryan Coogler, Sinners combines elements of the horror, action and thriller genres throughout its narrative. The story follows twin brothers willing to leave their troubled lives behind by returning to their hometown to start over from scratch, but who discover that an even greater evil awaits them.
textos.A experiência do filme constrói-se sobre: The experience of the film is built on a structure that alternates different rhythms, relying on an atmosphere marked by the constant use of music and the combination of multiple narrative genres.
textos.Os diferentes grupos avaliativos concent: The different rating groups focus on the same characteristics and agree on what the film presents, disagreeing essentially on the verdict about its execution. In the vast majority of ratings (~87%), about half highlight Michael B. Jordan's performance, while about half praise the soundtrack and the musical direction. In addition, a good portion emphasize the treatment of the message about racism and Black culture.
textos.Na perspectiva de quem compõe uma fração: From the perspective of those who make up a minimal fraction of ratings (~10%), a significant share point to an unbalanced structure, with a promising start and a drop at the end. In this stratum, several point to a mismatch between the expectation generated by the hype and the result delivered, although a considerable number still treat the soundtrack and the songs as evident qualities. Finally, from the point of view of an even smaller fraction of ratings (~3%), many condemn the slow, drawn-out pace of the production, a good portion criticize the script as confusing and poorly developed, and some express dissatisfaction with the cinematography and the direction.
